summary: The operative verdict is the breaker's exact low-energy lift against the hash-locked canonical margin-only single-product-tag completion. No intended maximal-order O/P^2 NAND/fusion/COPY candidate was supplied, so this does not settle such an unspecified tile. In the serialized 18-variable completion, each COPY orientation has a 22x18 emitted matrix and a 40x18 factor. All 16 legal cell/orientation fibers have squared energy E=18. The known pair movement (-1,1,1,-1,1,-1,-1,1) is conformally primitive in the emitted kernel, preserves every residual and both tag components, and yields a malformed vector of squared distance 42 in every fiber, below 306=17E. Exact shell search covers 25856 pair selectors through pair energy 32. A separate 36x18 decoded-margin serialization independently gives the same 42-energy lifts. Lean proves the conditional structural obstruction: whenever three integrally independent seam directions survive every non-transfer row, one bounded nonzero integer combination also survives, has zero F_17^2 leading transfer, coefficients in [-8,8], and squared coefficient weight at most 192. The theorem does not establish survival or CVP energy for the missing full tile. Q1 and Q2 remain open; no hardness or dimension-gap claim follows.
hypothesis: Selected only the cross-review-authorized Fable Proposal 1 / Pro Proposal 1 fixed-witness lift-or-kill audit. Causal mechanism: extra emitted NAND/COPY rows can rescue one product tag only by obstructing the certified zero-tag pair movement or forcing every exact lift to cost at least 17E. Expected frontier move: produce an SNF/left-kernel nonextension certificate or an exact full-factor counterexample. Falsification condition: a conformally primitive malformed movement survives every emitted row and has squared distance below 17E. Both serialized margin-only completions meet this condition in both COPY orientations, while the intended maximal-order candidate remains unavailable.

tests.finding: The hash-locked 36x18 decoded-margin factors in both orientations have 16 legal fibers at E=18; the exact pair movement survives every non-anchor row and gives malformed energy 42<306 in every fiber.

The canonical completion has two 22x18 emitted matrices and sixteen 40x18 factor/target instances. Exact search finds a conformally primitive zero-residual movement and malformed distance 42<17E in all 16 fibers, after enumerating 25856 pair selectors through pair energy 32.
Both deterministic Python verifiers compile successfully.
Mathlib compiles the universal residue-dependency, balanced-lift bounds, nonzero movement, row-survival, zero-transfer, and coefficient-weight theorems.

next_experiment: Require any proponent of a different single-product-tag construction to serialize and hash-lock the actual maximal-order NAND/fusion tile and both COPY orientations, including every anchor, normalization, legality, calibration, port, glue, pair-selector, pair-dependent, and O/P^2 tag row, together with the exact factor, targets, and common legal energy E. Apply the fixed movement first. A sub-17E exact lift kills that candidate. Failure to lift must be certified by SNF or an exact rational left-kernel witness and clears only this movement; an above-threshold extension requires exact minimization. Do not add tags, compute P^3 transitions, or claim Q1 before this discriminator is resolved on an actual candidate.
